name: portfolio-monorepo
description: Root package to run both portfolio applications

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix portfolio-inner-site && npm install --prefix portfolio-website
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm start --prefix portfolio-inner-site" "npm run dev --prefix portfolio-website"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix portfolio-inner-site && npm run build --prefix portfolio-website && rm -rf portfolio-website/public/inner-site && cp -r portfolio-inner-site/build portfolio-website/public/inner-site
